```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggplot2movies)
```

# Temporal analysis

Overview - Data
For the temporal data analysis, we want to group the data in decades and another set range. 

## Data manipulation

```{r}
movies <- ggplot2movies::movies

# A cutoff of on the first quartile
cutoff_votes <- 0

# Change the datatype 
clean_movies <- movies |>   
  map(~str_trim(.x)) |>   
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(-budget, -mpaa) |> 
  mutate_at(vars(-title), as.numeric) |>  
  mutate( as_date("%Y")) |> 
  filter(votes >= cutoff_votes) 
  
class(clean_movies)

summary(clean_movies$year)

```

Group per decade 

```{r}
# add variable decade
clean_movies <- clean_movies  |> 
  mutate(decade = if_else(year %in% seq(2000,2005, 1), paste0(year  %/% 10 * 10),
                  if_else(year %in% seq(1900, 1909, 1), paste0("190",(year - 1900) %/% 10 * 10), 
                  if_else(year %in% seq(1910, 1999, 1), paste0("19",(year - 1900) %/% 10 * 10), 
                          "1890")))) |> arrange (year) 

clean_movies$decade <- as.numeric(clean_movies$decade)

mean_ratings_decade <- clean_movies |> 
  group_by(decade) |> 
  mutate(mean_rating_decade = mean(rating)) 

by_decades <- clean_movies |> group_by(decade)

overview_decades <- by_decades |> tally(name = "number of movies")

saveRDS(clean_movies, "shiny_sanne/data/clean_movies.rds")
saveRDS(overview_decades, "shiny_sanne/data/movies_per_decade.rds")

table(clean_movies$decades, clean_movies$mean_votes_decade)

```

The dates of the movies range from 1893 - 2005.

We can create a range in intervals of 5 to 10 years.

Decades:

- 1893 -1899 (7 years)
- 1900 - 1909
- 1910 - 1919
- 1920 - 1929
- 1930 - 1939
- 1940 - 1949
- 1950 - 1959
- 1960 - 1969
- 1970 - 1979
- 1980 - 1989
- 1990 - 1999
- 2000 - 2005 (5 years)

```{r}
ggplot(clean_movies, aes(year, rating)) + 
  geom_point()

clean_movies <- clean_movies |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  mutate(mean_rating = mean(rating), mean_votes = mean(votes)) 

ggplot(clean_movies, aes(year, mean_rating)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  xlab("Year of movie release") +
  ylab("Average rating (0 - 10")


ggplot(clean_movies, aes(year, mean_votes)) + 
  geom_line(colour="#69b3a2") +
  geom_point() + 
  xlab("year of movies") +
  ylab("number of votes (mean)")

```

```{r}
apply(clean_movies, 2, plot)

table(clean_movies$year)
summary(clean_movies$year)
```


Normalise the average score per year on the number of movies released
- Per decade too... 

```{r}
hist(clean_movies$year)

ggplot(clean_movies, aes(year)) + 
  geom_bar(fill = "#69b3a2", colour = "#000000") +
  xlab("year of movie release") +
  ylab("number of movies")

```


```{r}
linear_model <- lm(mean_rating ~ year, data=clean_movies)
summary(linear_model)

plot(linear_model)
```


Compute the average rating per year per genre

```{r}
subset_action <- clean_movies |> 
  filter(Action == 1)
  
subset_action <- subset_action |>  group_by(year) |> 
  mutate(mean_rating_action = mean(rating), mean_votes_action = mean(votes))
  
subset_action <- group_by(decade) |>
  mutate(mean_rating_action_decades = mean(rating), mean_votes_action_decades = mean(votes))


```

runApp("shiny_sanne")
